lensXraySay: X-ray lens. Point at anything to see how it is made.
lensMakersSay: Makers lens. Point at anything to see who made it.
lensFlagSay: Flag lens. Pick the piece you want to report or wish for.
lensesOffSay: Lenses off. The system works as usual; the rims show the goggles are still on.
followingSay: Following {name}: everything they made is outlined. Click any piece to see who else made it.
putOnSay: You are seeing what the Future Traveler sees. Point at anything to see how it is made.
holdingSay: Holding still on {tag}. Press Escape to let go.
ownerNative: HTML standard: W3C and the browser
ownerOutside: Not from HAX; who made it is not known here
nothingOnScreen: Nothing they made is on this screen right now. Open the editor or another page and their pieces light up.
shotFailedSay: The screenshot could not be made here, so the issue carries the X-ray snapshot instead.
shotReadySay: Screenshot ready. It goes to your clipboard when you open the issue, so you can paste it in.
shotBlockedSay: Your browser blocked copying the picture. Right-click the screenshot and choose Copy image, then paste it into the issue.
shotCopiedSay: Screenshot copied. In the issue, click where it says to paste, then press Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac).
copyBlockedSay: Copy was blocked by the browser. Select the text instead.
flaggedSay: Flagged {tag}. Describe what you saw or what you wish it did.
notRegistered: This piece is not in the HAX registry, so its history is not known here.
agentCommits: {commits} more made with coding agents, steered by the people above.
shotFailedCaption: X-ray snapshot, {w} x {h} px. A screenshot could not be made here.
shotAltWhole: Screenshot of the screen with {tag} outlined
shotCaption: {w} x {h} px PNG, {kb} KB. If copying is blocked, right-click the picture and choose Copy image.
whatDoYouWish: What do you wish it did?
lensTranslateSay: Translate lens. Every outlined piece of text can be improved. Tap one.
txPickLangHint: HAX switches to it, so you see the words people really see. You can change it any time.
txShareLink: Copy a link for a {lang} speaker
txLinkCopied: Link copied. Whoever opens it gets this page in {lang} with the Translate lens on.
txKeep: Keep {tokens} exactly as written: HAX puts a value there.
txNote: A note for us (any language, optional)
txEmpty: Nothing yet. Tap any outlined words to start.
txSendHint: Opens a ready-made report. Sign in to GitHub and press Create. You do not need to change anything in it.
txCopied: Copied. Paste it in an email or chat to the HAX team.
txSameAsNow: Your words are the same as now.
txLookingAt: {en}, now {now}. Press Enter to suggest better words.
txLookingMissing: {en}, not translated yet. Press Enter to translate it.
noChecksFound: The automatic checks found nothing here. Describe what got in the way.
checkControlName: Button or link without a name
alreadyReported: Already reported? Look first, and +1 it there instead.
replayHelp: A replay lets a maintainer open this on a scratch site and see the problem. Files from your site are swapped for placeholders.
replayTooBig: This replay is too big for the link. Download it and drag the file into the issue.
githubAccount: Reports go to GitHub; you need a GitHub account.
